details.r3_exit_interpretation: The driver finally calls native.stop(), which calls process.terminate() if the app is still alive, waits 8 seconds, then kill() only on timeout; report exit_code -15 is therefore consistent with that explicit cleanup signal. This is not an app crash signal in context and not app exit success; report main returns 0 on PASS status, while the child is deliberately terminated during cleanup.
